meta.title: Teuchi Ramen Iyomaru Suisan | Handmade Ramen in Furano, Hokkaido
meta.description: A fisherman-run ramen shop in Furano, Hokkaido, 2-3 min walk from JR Furano Station. Handmade noodles from Furano wheat, paired with seafood fresh off the boat.
meta.ogTitle: Teuchi Ramen Iyomaru Suisan | Handmade Ramen in Furano
meta.ogDescription: Handmade noodles from Furano wheat, and seafood so fresh it comes straight from the owner's own boat.

hero.tagline: Handmade Ramen, Straight from Furano's Fishing Boats.
hero.ratingNote: Ratings change over time — check Google Maps for the latest.

items.title: Handmade Noodles
items.text: Made fresh in-house every day using Haruyutaka wheat and eggs from Furano. Chewy, springy, and full of character.

items.title: Furano-Grown Ingredients
items.text: From the wheat to the eggs, we lean on what Furano's soil does best — real Hokkaido flavor, bowl after bowl.

items.title: Straight From Our Own Boats
items.text: The owner is an actual fisherman, so the seafood arrives fresher than most. Shrimp, octopus, crab — piled on generously, no middleman required.

menu.title: Signature Bowls
menu.priceNote: Prices shown are placeholders pending final confirmation — please ask in-store or by phone for current pricing.

items.name: Crab Miso Ramen
items.desc: A rich miso broth built on a slow-simmered crab stock from hairy crab and king crab. The sea, concentrated in one bowl.

items.name: Backfat Miso Ramen
items.desc: A hearty, rich miso ramen finished with savory pork backfat — a perfect match for our handmade Furano-wheat noodles.

items.name: Iyomaru SPECIAL
items.desc: Three kinds of Hidaka seafood, piled on generously. This is what a fisherman-run ramen shop can do.

items.name: Octopus Rice
items.desc: Rice slow-cooked with octopus, soaking up all that flavor. The perfect companion to your ramen.

hours.title: Hours & Access

hours.access: 2–3 min walk from JR Furano Station (across from Asahikawa Shinkin Bank)
hours.parking: Free parking available (approx. 5 spaces, behind "Teppanyaki Masaya" nearby)
hours.seats: 14 seats total (4 counter seats + tables) — private bookings available for up to 20 guests
payments: PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay & other QR payments
